relationships.evidence_quote: also reversed the increased frequency of IPSCs recorded in layer 5 pyramidal neurons of the contralateral SSC in CFA-injected mice

key_findings: CFA-induced chronic inflammatory pain progressively increased perineuronal net density and PNN-enwrapped PV interneurons in the somatosensory cortex, mPFC and reticular thalamic nucleus.
Intracortical chondroitinase-ABC degradation of PNNs in the SSC reduced mechanical and thermal pain and reversed increased IPSC frequency in layer 5 pyramidal neurons.
